description: This file implements the 'git difftool' command, acting as a wrapper around an external diff tool and handling directory and file diffs within the Git version control system. It includes functions for parsing diff output, handling symlinks, submodules, and working tree changes, and controls the invocation of external diff tools or helper scripts.

methods.name: int parse_index_info(struct repository * repo,char * p,int * mode1,int * mode2,struct object_id * oid1,struct object_id * oid2,char * status)
methods.description: Parses a line of index info from the diff output, extracting modes, object IDs, and status.

methods.name: void add_path(struct strbuf * buf,size_t base_len,const char * path)
methods.description: Removes trailing slash from directory path and appends a new subpath.

methods.name: int use_wt_file(struct repository * repo,const char * workdir,const char * name,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines if a file in the working tree can be reused based on its object ID.

methods.name: char * get_symlink(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const struct object_id * oid,const char * path)
methods.description: Reads symlink content either from the filesystem or from the object database, depending on the object ID.

methods.name: int checkout_path(unsigned mode,struct object_id * oid,const char * path,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Checks out a given path with specified mode and object ID into the working directory.

methods.name: void write_file_in_directory(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * dir,size_t dir_len,const char * path,const char * content)
methods.description: Writes file contents to a specified directory, creating leading directories as needed.

methods.name: void write_standin_files(struct repository * repo,struct pair_entry * entry,struct strbuf * ldir,size_t ldir_len,struct strbuf * rdir,size_t rdir_len)
methods.description: Creates placeholder files for submodules and symlinks for diff visualization.

methods.name: int run_dir_diff(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const char * extcmd,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Handles directory diff mode: sets up temporary directories, runs the diff, and invokes external tools.

methods.name: int run_file_diff(int prompt,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Runs diff on individual files, invoking external diff tools.

methods.name: int cmd_difftool(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main function executed for 'git difftool' command, parsing options, setting environment, and dispatching to appropriate diff modes.

methods.name: void add_left_or_right(struct hashmap * map,const char * path,const char * content,int is_right)
void changed_files(struct repository * repo,struct hashmap * result,const char * index_path,const char * workdir)
int difftool_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)

int working_tree_entry_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
